traits: bold title, description, optional arrow link

contentPattern.structure: 1 column, one row per step (merged or split cells are combined). Content in order: the step number as the first paragraph ("1", "2."; optional, generated from the position when omitted), H3 title, description paragraph(s), optional CTA: a last paragraph that holds only a link is rendered as an arrow link. Empty rows are skipped. No label rows; all texts are authored

usage: App-entry pages such as /{country}/{lang}/online-check-in ("Find your booking" ... "Personalize your flight").
reuseGuidance: Use for numbered how-to steps. For image teasers use cards-teaser; for icon cards use cards-icon-text.
